title: Skills Inventory
description: Machine-readable source of truth for governed skills. The Logseq page OS-LOG/Skills 当前状态清单 is a human mirror and is projected one way from this file.

updated_at.description: When this registry file was last written.

source_class.description: One of the classes in source-types.yaml.

review_time.description: Drift report field (ACM-142). Last review timestamp, or null when the record has not been reviewed.

baseline_ref.description: Drift report field (ACM-142). Pointer to the reviewed baseline. content_hash records use sha256:<64 hex of SKILL.md>. Skills CLI upstream_ref records use github:<lock source>. Runtime bundles use runtime:<provider>. Enabled plugins use plugin:<host>/<id>. Null only when baseline.kind is none.

current_version.description: Drift report field (ACM-142). Explicit compatibility version, usually SKILL.md metadata.version. Skills CLI records use the lock skillFolderHash, or null when that hash is empty. Runtime and plugin records use the provider version string. Null when Git history is the only version authority.

customization_mode.description: ACM-134. Which supported customization applies. none and policy_exclusion are not content deltas. wrapper, overlay, fork, and local_replacement require local_customization local_delta. unknown matches an unresolved local delta. ACM-131 owns the decision workflow; this field only records the result.

compatibility_constraints.description: ACM-134. Limits an install or customization must keep. Empty when none are recorded. A policy_exclusion should record its exclusion as a policy item. A content customization may also pin the upstream version, runtime, or adapter it was reviewed against.

visible_paths.description: Repo-relative paths, or absolute/~ paths. A Cursor plugin cache path uses one * segment in place of the content hash.

canonical_path.description: Repo-relative directory that contains SKILL.md. Null when this repository is not the canonical source.

subject.description: What baseline_ref points at. content_hash records use SKILL.md. Skills CLI upstream_ref records use the lock skillPath. Runtime and plugin records use the version file path.

value.description: upstream_version uses a baseline_ref-style coordinate. runtime names a provider such as cursor, codex, claude, or hermes. adapter names a path or adapter kind. policy is a short must-not or exclusion statement. unknown is unresolved constraint text.

path.description: Repo-relative path, or an absolute/~ path for a machine adapter outside this repository.

target.description: Symlink target text, or null when the adapter has no link target.
